title: Mom Shocked After Learning Teen Sons Are Wanted Killers

beats.description: Introduction of Tiffany and her sons, Tyler and Eli, as killers, setting a dark tone.
Recounting the morning of the crime, the brothers' activities, and the initial moments leading to the shooting.
The shooting occurs, police arrive, initial witness interviews, and the discovery of the victim and his residence.
Victim identification, introduction of Sierra Collins, and her initial interview where she implicates the Chaffen brothers.
The manhunt for the Chaffen brothers, their arrest, and the initial conversations in the police vehicle.
Interviews with Tyler and Eli, their conflicting stories, and the introduction of their mother, Tiffany.
Eli's confession of the murder, with Tiffany present, and the detective challenging their self-defense narrative.
Tyler's final interview, his insistence on being set up by Sierra, and the detective's assessment of the brothers' guilt.
Tiffany's continued support for her sons, jail calls, and the legal proceedings.
Sierra's death due to a medical emergency and the Chaffen brothers entering plea agreements.
Sentencing of Eli and Tyler, concluding the narrative with their prison terms.

_analysis_metadata.transcript_preview: This is Tiffany, mother of Tyler and Eli Chaffen. Just hours earlier, her two sons brutally killed a man and left his body by the side of the road. >> I felt I had to shoot wheels to make sure my brother didn't get hurt. This police are always trying to protect the children. >> As Tiffany listens in horror, the brothers insist they were only protecting each other. But the truth is far darker. >> Over the next 24 hours, Tiffany will face the worst day of her life as she slowly pieces together the horrifying truth that she's raised two terrifying killers. >> And your brother, your brother murdered somebody. >> I love you very much. ...
